title: Social surfaces are not synonymous with platforms
summary: Provider-scoped surface identity supports messaging, email discussions, video creator comments, marketplace product reviews and seller communications, local-business reviews, Reddit, Discord and Steam.
invariants: Provider ID, family, resource ID and visibility define a surface; item IDs are scoped by surface.
Do not equate public comment, private group, product Q&A, developer reply, moderation action and paid placement.
Published platform names are semantic example profiles; live API permissions, rate limits and regional restrictions must be discovered per provider and per account.

provenance.claim: Steam and other off-network social example surfaces
